ValidationRule.description: Blocks creating a new funding tier or changing its funding amount/income level — unless the user has the finance controls override flag turned on.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Funding_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(IncomeLevel__c) ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($User.IVF_Finance_Controls__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to create or edit funding tiers.
